prompt: Make the Box record satisfy the provided Sized interface with area(), and add a static factory method square(side).
explanation: Records can implement interfaces just like classes; Box supplies the area() implementation that Sized demands, so a Box can be used anywhere a Sized is expected. Static factory methods such as square are a common way to give records convenient alternative constructors. The tests also use the auto-generated accessors width() and height().
hints: area() is just width * height -- the record components are in scope inside instance methods.
square is static, so it cannot read width or height -- it builds a new Box using the one side length for both components.
